report_identity.report_title: Shanghai Gench Education Group Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates Shanghai Jian Qiao University, a for-profit private higher education institution in Shanghai, with revenue mainly from tuition fees, boarding fees, education related and training services.

segments.business_substance: Tuition fees, boarding fees, education related and training services, and other services.

business_overview.revenue_model: Students generally pay tuition and boarding fees in advance before the academic year; revenue is recognised over the relevant program period.
business_notes: The university had 24,182 full-time enrolled students in the 2025/26 school year.
New undergraduate tuition for 2025/26 was RMB42,000-48,000 per school year, and junior college tuition was RMB23,000.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Government grant income included in other income and gains.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported cash conversion is strong in 2025, but it includes advance tuition/boarding fee mechanics and government grant cash receipts. Campus capital expenditure remains material, and mainland education company cash is not assumed freely distributable to the offshore listed parent.

gaps: The 2025 annual report does not split cash by listed parent, offshore intermediate holding companies, PRC subsidiaries and school/VIE-like operating entities.
Only 2024 and 2025 operating cash flow and capital expenditure were available from this report; 2023 cash flow was not re-extracted from a separate 2023 annual report.
The exact maturity schedule and redemption restrictions of 2025 wealth management products and certificates of deposit were not disclosed in the extracted passages.
